organization.name: Burke Software and Consulting
organization.notes: Official Who is making this identifies Burke Software and Consulting as creator; HIPAA page identifies Burke Software as operator. Exact company formation year, outside equity funding and investors not disclosed in reviewed pages; unknown rather than bootstrapped.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted
pricingTiers.notes: Self-hosted version runs on own server; optional infrastructure charges separate. Hosted Free has 1, 000 events/month.
No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Medium
pricingTiers.notes: Hosted plan for growing businesses; up to 500, 000 events/month. Annual discount exists but annual total is not published.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise / HIPAA contract
pricingTiers.notes: HIPAA page invites contact to discuss Enterprise pricing. Hosted Large separately lists $250/month; no fabricated custom-contract amount.

moats.claim: Sentry protocol compatibility reduces adoption friction, while the open protocol also limits proprietary lock-in as a moat.

productReasons.claim: Sentry-compatible SDK ingestion can preserve familiar application instrumentation while changing error triage backend.
Error, uptime and performance views combine failure investigation with availability checks.
Unlimited projects and team membership simplify organizing error work across applications.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.component: All-in-one service or separate web/worker services
requirements.notes: All-in-one supports small instances; separate workers scale independently.
Current guide explicitly optional, not a universal production requirement.
EMAIL_URL may use consolemail:// if no email desired.
Railway buckets are a documented option.

requirements.component: nginx or Apache reverse proxy and TLS

resources.storage: Usage-dependent; example 30 GB for 1 million events/month
resources.notes: Guide allows carefully configured 128 MB plus swap; 512 MB is recommended, disk figure is an example.

selfHosting.notes: Current guide documents all-in-one and separate worker routes; Postgre SQL required, Redis/Valkey optional. Hardware guide is not a workload guarantee.

options.name: Railway Glitch Tip template
options.notes: Official installation page links template deploying all-in-one app, Postgre SQL and Redis.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official guide links Railway, Pika Pods, Elestio, Nodion and Repo Cloud. Railway template verified; ordinary Compose instructions kept separate.
